t: No Nonsense Gaffer Tape is a heavy duty, clear adhesive tape designed for robust performance. This versatile gaffer tape is suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications, making it ideal for securing cables on site or making temporary repairs in workshops. It offers reliable adhesion on rough and imperfect surfaces, including concrete flooring, metal, rubber, wood, and plastic. The 50 mesh construction ensures durability, and the tape can be easily torn to the required size, either horizontally or vertically, for efficient use. Its water-resistant properties provide dependable performance in various trade tasks.
b: Heavy Duty Gaffer Tape for Tough Jobs
Bonds to Concrete, Metal, Rubber & Wood
